title: The hub cannot print the twelve words a lead compares when re-admitting it
remediation: Re-admitting your organization's server after a rollback or fork finding (hub.readmit, signed by the lead's or deputy's person key) is allowed only after the lead compares twelve words worked out from the certificate pin of the server SovAI now reaches (serverPinWords) with the server's operator. The hub has no command that prints those twelve words, and the operator guide gives no other way to work them out, so the operator has nothing to compare against and the check that the right server is trusted again rests on the lead alone. Until it is built the operator guide says so, and an operator can print only the raw pin (relay/README.md, Certificates and pins). This closes when the hub's command line prints the twelve words from its own certificate key with the same function members' computers use, a test shows the words equal the ones SovAI shows for that pin, and relay/README.md's re-admit and restore steps use the command. Source: .planning/phases/33-live-multi-user-staff-projects/33-15-SUMMARY.md.

milestones.title: Add a hub command that prints the twelve words of its own certificate pin with serverPinWords, with a test against the words SovAI shows
